run_dataset_processing: run the script to process OpenAI's LM-Human-Preferences descriptiveness dataset into prompt-chosen-rejected format
filter_samples_not_all_same: filter dataset rows where all four samples are identical using the samples_not_all_same predicate
map_to_prompt_completion: map raw dataset examples to prompt-chosen-rejected pairs using GPT-2 tokenizer decoding
create_script_arguments: create a ScriptArguments dataclass with push_to_hub, repo_id, and dataset_num_proc CLI options
push_dataset_to_hub: push the processed dataset and model card to a Hugging Face Hub repository
